summary: After public anger over their own pay raise, members say the process fell short and one asks for a do-over.
realLife: Weeks after a council more than doubled its own pay, every member who spoke said the process was poor. One asked for a redo and said the job is far more than a few hours of meetings. Another doubted higher pay would bring better candidates, since recent elections drew many. Supporters said low pay turns service into a hobby for the wealthy. They agreed to bring back a smaller raise for a formal vote with public comment.
sources: TownLift (Park City, Utah), 'Park City Council rescinds doubled salaries, directs staff to draft a smaller raise', June 12, 2026: https://townlift.com/2026/06/park-city-council-rescinds-doubled-salaries-directs-staff-to-draft-a-smaller-raise/
